quote: We present a pipeline [...] that generates a scene illustration given a fragment in its story context.

We demonstrate that LLMs can articulate visual knowledge of narrative scenes by inferring this knowledge directly from story text... LLMs are an effective interface for transforming story text into prompts that facilitate text-to-image models to produce illustrations.
We define and motivate the task of narrative scene illustration in relation to existing research on visually aligned storytelling.
outputs: Scene illustrations and textual scene descriptions
scene descriptions (captions), text prompts, evaluation criteria

quote: We measured rater correctness in terms of linear-weighted κ agreement with the gold standard...

We implemented this by prompting a visually-enabled LLM (i.e. VLM) to assign responses to each criterion for a given illustration [...] The rater is asked to respond to each criterion (where a response of '✓' means the criterion is satisfied, '✗' means not satisfied, and '?' means 'maybe').

We then enlisted visually-enabled models to assess illustrations based on this criteria. ... We utilized three VLMs that have obtained notable performance on visual understanding benchmarks: CLAUDE-3.5, GPT-4O, and PIXTRAL.
We examine LLMs' capacity to generate evaluation criteria for the scene illustration task.
